After the flood, God spoke to Noah and his sons.
He blessed them: be fruitful, and fill the earth.
Human life is sacred, because God made people in his own image.
Then God made a covenant with Noah, his children, and every living creature.
Never again would a flood destroy the earth.
And God gave a sign: a bow in the clouds.
When it appears, God said, I will see it, and remember my promise.
He drank the wine, and lay uncovered in his tent.
His son Ham saw him, and told his brothers.
But Shem and Japheth took a cloak, walked in backward, and covered their father.
When Noah woke, he cursed Canaan, Ham's son, and blessed Shem and Japheth.
Noah lived 950 years. And the bow remained, a sign of God's everlasting covenant.
God's promise did not depend on Noah being perfect.
Noah fell short, but the bow still stood.
You may fail, and feel you've ruined everything. But God's faithfulness is bigger than your worst day.
So when you see a rainbow, remember: God keeps his promises.
What promise of God are you holding on to today?
